findings.title: Unintended 10x increase in cleanup frequency
findings.body: In pkg/services/cleanup/cleanup.go the ticker was changed from time.Minute*10 to time.Minute*1 with no mention in the PR description. This runs all cleanup jobs (snapshots, versions, images, annotations, invites, short URLs, query history) every minute instead of every 10 minutes, increasing DB and IO load 10x and making the annotation cleanup that this PR is trying to de-escalate run far more often.

findings.title: Leftover Error-level debug logging floods logs
findings.body: In pkg/services/annotations/annotationsimpl/xorm_store.go CleanAnnotations and CleanOrphanedAnnotationTags log every batch with r.log.Error including the full ids slice, cond, and err which is nil on success. With batch sizes up to 32767 this emits tens of thousands of IDs per batch at Error level on every cleanup cycle, polluting error logs, triggering false alerts, and causing log volume and performance problems. These statements should be removed or demoted to Debug.
